title: schoenus pauciflorus
intro: Schoenus pauciflorus, commonly known as Few-flowered Bog-rush, is a plant species belonging to the sedge family. It is reported to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of arthritis and other inflammatory conditions. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents of Schoenus pauciflorus include phenolic compounds and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
